verdict.rationale: Apify's docs describe a built-in scheduling capability that will "automatically start Actors and saved tasks at specific times." Saved tasks "can be run multiple times," and webhooks can chain one Actor run to another to form workflows. However, the evidence is a one-line feature summary that never explicitly states recurrence (for example cron-style intervals), so recurring scheduling is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/cron schedule definitions, schedule management via API/CLI, schedule configuration depth (timezones, intervals), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automatically start Actors and saved tasks at specific times.
Tasks are saved in the Apify platform and can be run multiple times.
you can use webhooks to start another Actor when an Actor run finishes or fails.
